questionText:

"Aisha, a volunteer at a nationwide suicide prevention helpline, underwent rigorous training in active listening and crisis intervention. On standardized normal distribution curves, an IQ of 130 and above (more than two standard deviations above the mean) classifies an individual as intellectually gifted.

Therefore, option (B) is the correct answer.
